en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: pooraa satigur jaaneeaai poore pooraa thaaT banaiaa|

en.bdb: One should understand the perfect true Guru who has created the grandeur (of creation) around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: poore pooraa saadhasa(n)g poore pooraa ma(n)trr dhiraRaiaa|

en.bdb: The holy congregation of the complete is perfect and that perfect has recited the perfect mantra.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: poore pooraa piram ras pooraa gurmukh pa(n)th chalaiaa|

en.bdb: The perfect has created the complete love for the Lord and has ordained the gurmukh way of life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਦਰਸਣੋ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: poore pooraa dharasano poore pooraa sabadh sunaiaa|

en.bdb: The  sight of perfect is perfect and the same perfect has caused to hear the perfect word.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: poore pooraa baihanaa poore pooraa takhat rachaiaa|

en.bdb: His sitting is also perfect and his throne is also perfect.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਖੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੁਇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: saadh sa(n)gat sach kha(n)dd hai bhagat vachhal hui vasagat aaiaa|

en.bdb: The holy congregation is the abode of truth and being kind to the devotee, He is in the possession of the devotees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਿਖਾ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sach roop sach naau gur giaan dhiaan sikhaa samajhaiaa|

en.bdb: The Guru, out of his sheer love for the Sikhs, has made them understand the true nature of the Lord, the true name and the knowledge-producing meditation.
The Guru has immersed the disciple in the way of life.
